root_idea.summary: The root centers on ornament and adornment, together with the visible qualities or appearance associated with ornament.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence extends from acquiring, applying, and wearing physical ornaments to describing a person’s qualities or appearance, with derived forms also expressing self-adornment and affectation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form حَلَّى.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form حِلْيَة.
حُلِيّ is the Quranic plural/collective counterpart of حِلْيَة and is presented under the singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To adorn or deck someone with ornaments.
senses.usage_conditions: All supplied Quran occurrences are passive Form II forms, describing people as being adorned; the cited construction is transitive in the ornaments applied.
In the supplied Quran occurrences, the term denotes physical ornaments or adornment; the related Quranic plural form حُلِيّ is included under this citation form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign or give ornaments to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I; the supplied evidence gives the construction with a person receiving ornaments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquire, possess, or wear an ornament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I; these uses describe having or wearing ornament rather than causing another person to be decked.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gain or derive profit, advantage, or benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied evidence records this idiomatic use chiefly in negative phrases.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an ornament for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form II use distinct from decking someone with an already existing ornament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To describe a person, thing, or its qualities and attributes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; the object described may be a person’s qualities, state, or condition, or these may be described to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adorn oneself with an ornament or make an ornament for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V reflexive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect or claim qualities that one does not possess.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recognize or know a person’s qualities, attributes, state, or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V use connected with حِلْيَة in the sense of a person’s defining qualities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s qualities, aggregate attributes, state, form, or outward appearance; also a description of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the descriptive sense of the noun, not the physical ornament sense attested in the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The distinguishing marking of the limbs in the prescribed ablution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage in discussion of ablution, identified with tahjīl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decorative fitting or ornament, especially one applied to a sword, lamp, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical object-specific use of the ornament term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pustules breaking out in the mouths of children, reportedly after a fever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare medical or colloquial lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cry used to chide a she-camel or female camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal animal-driving expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry, dried up, or tough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dried and whitish pasture plant or grass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use, including the named desert pasture plants described in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pole or long piece of wood between the two bulls of a plough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional agricultural term reported for the dialect of Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An Arab food made by rubbing or pressing dates together by hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized food term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who has or wears an ornament or ornaments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description derived from the ornament sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Trees bearing leaves and fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical use explicitly marked as such in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ornamented or decorated, especially said of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial adjectival use.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I assigning or giving ornaments.
Quran-attested decking sense plus making and describing uses.
General ornament sense and object-specific decorative fittings.
Cry used to chide female camels.
Dry whitish pasture vegetation and its botanical designation.
Tropical use for trees bearing leaves and fruit.
Bracketed editorial gloss without an independent lexical branch.

cautions: The Quranic Form II verb occurrences are passive, while the public headword is normalized to the active perfect citation form حَلَّى.
The packet contains no Maqayis entry; the root-level orientation therefore reflects the supplied Lane and Mufradat evidence rather than an independent Maqayis formulation.
Rare botanical, agricultural, animal-related, and technical uses are kept as Classical Arabic meanings and are not folded into the Quranic ornament senses.
